tools.name: get_product_info
tools.description: Facts about AI360Feedback, the free AI 360-degree feedback tool: what it does, pricing (free and PRO), anonymity, privacy, languages and how a 360 works. Use it before answering questions about the product.

tools.name: compare_with
tools.description: Compare AI360Feedback with another 360 feedback tool (e.g. Lattice, Culture Amp, 15Five, Spidergap, Effy, SurveyMonkey): pricing, free option, contract, AI. Returns a table and a link.

tools.name: start_360
tools.description: Get the link to start a free 360-degree feedback (for yourself) or a PRO campaign (to run 360s for clients or employees), with the next steps. The person answers on the website.

tools.name: check_360_status
tools.description: Check the progress of the user's own 360 from the private link in their 360 email (…/campaigns/access/…): self-assessment done, number of reviewer answers, deadline, whether the report is ready. Returns counts only, never names, emails or feedback.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_product_info" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Facts about AI360Feedback, the free AI 360-degree feedback tool: what it does, pricing (free and PRO), anonymity, privacy, languages and how a 360 works. Use it…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_360_status · Private data: check_360_status · Public sink: check_360_status · Destructive: start_360.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_360_status · Private data: check_360_status · Public sink: check_360_status · Destructive: start_360

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
